boundary: Dated research snapshot for citation and comparison. This is not a live quote, not a trading recommendation, and not a referral or campaign eligibility claim.

findings.statement: Across the four reviewed Perp DEX venues, all 24 required venue-field records are source-backed as known, and every venue still requires cost review across fee, funding, collateral, margin, oracle and liquidation fields rather than a single static fee or live funding quote.
findings.method: Count known status records across the six required fields for Hyperliquid, dYdX, GMX and Aevo, then review the limitation notes for live-rate, market-specific, tier-specific and liquidation dependencies.

evidence.limitSummary: Base fee tier, funding, leverage, margin tier, oracle and liquidation behavior are condition-dependent.
Fee schedules, funding, margin fractions and liquidation parameters are market-specific or governance/community adjustable.
Position fees are only one part of the stack; price impact, borrowing, funding, oracle pricing, liquidity and market configuration can change costs.
Published standard fee and ETH perp parameters are dated examples; funding, collateral support, portfolio margin and liquidation rules remain instrument-specific.

findings.limitations: This finding is derived from the dated Wave48 source matrix. It is not a live-rate feed, venue ranking, trading recommendation, registration route, referral claim or account eligibility decision.

fieldShape.limits: limits and caveats for this field

venues.name: Hyperliquid
limits: Fee tiers, staking discounts, aligned quote asset rules, HIP-3 deployer settings, and growth mode can change the all-in fee.
Funding is market-specific and changes hourly; this snapshot records the protocol formula, not a live rate.
Max leverage and maintenance margin depend on the asset and margin tier.

fee.value: Perps tier 0 base rate: 0.045% taker, 0.015% maker; lower tiers and staking discounts may apply.
fee.limits: Base tier only; all-in rate can be modified by user tier, staking, aligned quote assets, referral discounts, HIP-3 deployer fee scale, and growth mode.

funding.value: Hourly peer-to-peer funding; no fee collected on funding payments. Formula uses premium plus a clamped interest component and spot oracle notional conversion.
funding.limits: Records mechanism only; live funding by market must be fetched separately.

collateral.value: Deposits are credited to cross margin balance; isolated margin can allocate margin to a specific position.
collateral.limits: The source establishes margin-balance behavior, not a complete collateral token matrix for every listed or HIP-3 market.

margin.value: Cross margin is default; isolated and strict-isolated modes exist. Required opening margin is position_size * mark_price / leverage.
margin.limits: Asset-specific max leverage and margin tiers must be checked at trade time.

oracle.value: Funding uses spot oracle price; oracle prices are computed by validators as weighted medians of CEX spot prices.
oracle.limits: The liquidation page separately notes mark price combines external CEX prices with Hyperliquid book state.

liquidation.value: Liquidation occurs when account equity drops below maintenance margin; most liquidations are sent to the book, with backstop liquidation below 2/3 maintenance margin.
liquidation.limits: Liquidation price can move with funding, PnL, other cross positions, and asset-specific maintenance leverage.

venues.name: dYdX
limits: dYdX docs state fee schedules and risk parameters are subject to governance/community adjustment.
Funding, margin fractions, and liquidation parameters are market-specific and should be checked through current market/API state before use.
The docs point users to the frontend for the latest fee schedule.

fee.value: Official docs list tier 1 as 5.0 bps taker and 1.0 bps maker for 30d trailing volume under $1M.
fee.sourceLabel: dYdX Documentation - Rewards, Fees and Parameters
fee.limits: Governance-adjustable; docs advise checking the dYdX frontend fees page for latest schedule.

funding.value: Hourly funding based on premium samples; formula is (Premium Component / 8) + Interest Rate Component.
funding.limits: This is the mechanism, not a live market rate; isolated market interest settings can differ.

collateral.value: Total account value includes the quote asset USDC balance plus position value; quoteBalance changes with transfers, position changes, funding, and liquidations.
collateral.limits: Records margin accounting from docs; current supported deposits and operational availability must be checked separately.

margin.value: Markets have initial and maintenance margin fractions; single-position requirements are abs(size * oracle price * fraction).
margin.limits: Initial margin can scale with open interest; market liquidity tier parameters can change.

oracle.value: Margin and liquidation calculations use oracle price for market valuation.
oracle.limits: This asset does not enumerate all oracle source constituents; it records the documented dependency on oracle price.

liquidation.value: Accounts whose total value falls below maintenance margin may have positions automatically closed by the liquidation engine; maximum liquidation penalty is documented as 1.5%.
liquidation.limits: Penalty and liquidation configuration are governance-adjustable; position may be partially or fully closed.

venues.name: GMX
limits: GMX fees include position fees, swap fees, price impact, borrowing, funding, and network/execution costs.
Market configuration, risk oracle parameters, liquidity depth, and chain can change current costs.
GMX V2 uses flexible collateral and oracle-based pricing, so exposure can differ from standard stablecoin-margined linear perps.

fee.value: Open/close position fee is commonly 0.04% or 0.06% of position size depending on whether the trade improves or worsens long/short open interest balance.
fee.limits: TradFi markets and market-specific parameters can differ; price impact and borrowing/funding are additional costs or credits.

funding.value: Funding fees may be a cost or credit while a position is open; rate changes over time based on long/short market balance.
funding.limits: Live funding rate is visible in interface; snapshot records mechanism only.

collateral.value: GMX V2 uses linear USD-based PnL with flexible collateral; positions can use wallet funds or GMX Account funds depending on chain and flow.
collateral.limits: Supported chains and deposit/withdrawal tokens differ between direct wallet trading and GMX Account.

margin.value: Position rows expose size, net value, collateral, leverage, mark price, and liquidation price; max leverage derives from market risk configuration.
margin.sourceLabel: GMX Docs - Positions and order types
margin.limits: Max leverage can change by market, liquidity, session, and interface caps.

oracle.value: GMX uses oracle-based pricing sourced from aggregated exchange data to reduce liquidation risk from temporary wicks.
oracle.limits: TradFi markets have additional freshness thresholds and risk oracle parameters.

liquidation.value: A position is liquidated when remaining collateral after losses, accrued fees, and capped negative price impact falls below the market minimum collateral threshold, typically 0.25% to 1% of position size.
liquidation.limits: Effective threshold is the greater of percentage threshold and absolute minimum collateral floor; borrow and funding fees move liquidation price over time.

venues.name: Aevo
limits: Aevo docs still show standard perpetual fees while also saying standard fees will soon be reduced following AGP-3 approval; treat values as a dated docs snapshot until the current fee schedule is verified.
Perp specs are shown for ETH perpetuals as an official representative contract; other assets can differ.
Portfolio margin can alter requirements for hedged multi-instrument accounts.

fee.value: Perpetuals standard fees: 0.08% taker and 0.05% maker; ETH perpetual spec repeats these values.
fee.limits: Multiple fee tiers are available; the official page includes a 'will soon get reduced' AGP-3 note, so this asset does not claim a current all-in rate.

funding.value: Funding payments are peer-to-peer every 1 hour; Aevo does not charge a fee on funding.
funding.sourceLabel: Aevo Documentation - Perpetual Futures Funding Rate
funding.limits: Mechanism only; live funding varies by market and time, and Aevo documents nonstandard funding intervals for selected instruments plus authority to modify intervals in extreme volatility.

collateral.value: Aevo supports options, perpetuals, and structured products in a unified single margin account; ETH perps quote asset is USDC.
collateral.limits: This summarizes the unified margin system and representative ETH perp quote asset, not every supported deposit asset.

margin.value: ETH perpetual futures spec: 5% initial margin, 3% maintenance margin, 20x max leverage; portfolio margin may reduce requirements for hedged portfolios.
margin.limits: Representative ETH perp values; other contracts can have different parameters.

oracle.value: Aevo uses a custom internal oracle and constructs an index from spot prices on centralized exchanges after filtering disconnected or deviating sources.
oracle.limits: ETH index constituents are documented; constituent sets for other assets must be checked individually.

liquidation.value: Cross-margin portfolio liquidation starts when account balance minus open orders minus maintenance margin breaches requirements; process cancels orders, incrementally liquidates, then can use insurance fund or ADL.
liquidation.limits: Liquidation fee is asset-tier dependent; ETH perp spec lists 1% of liquidated position value.
